questions.q: Which national hero fought the Ottomans in the 1400s?
questions.why: His statue stands in Tirana's main square.

questions.q: In which year did Albania declare independence?
questions.why: It was declared in Vlorë.

questions.q: Which communist leader ruled Albania from 1944 to 1985?
questions.why: He isolated the country.

questions.q: Who declared Albania's independence in 1912?
questions.why: He became the first head of government.

questions.q: Which king ruled Albania from 1928 to 1939?
questions.why: He fled when Italy invaded.

questions.q: Which country invaded Albania in 1939?
questions.why: Mussolini ordered it.

questions.q: Which 1997 crisis followed the collapse of pyramid schemes?
questions.why: Many people lost their savings.

questions.q: Which 1908 congress agreed a Latin alphabet for Albanian?
questions.why: It met in today's Bitola.

questions.q: Which ancient Greek and Roman city near Saranda is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: Its ruins are in a national park.

questions.q: Which ancient Greek colony near Fier was famous for learning?
questions.why: Augustus studied there as a young man.

questions.q: What is the capital of Albania?
questions.why: It has been the capital since 1920.

questions.q: Which two seas lie along Albania's coast?
questions.why: The Albanian Riviera faces the Ionian.

questions.q: Which 'city of a thousand windows' is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: Its white houses climb the hill.

questions.q: Which stone city is the birthplace of Enver Hoxha?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which port city has a large Roman amphitheatre?
questions.why: It is Albania's main port.

questions.q: Which river is one of Europe's last wild rivers?
questions.why: It became a national park in 2023.

questions.q: Which mountains in the north are called the 'Accursed Mountains'?
questions.why: Theth and Valbona are there.

questions.q: Which lake shared with Montenegro is Albania's largest?
questions.why: It is called Skadar in Montenegro.

questions.q: Which 1878 league defended Albanian lands?
questions.why: It met in today's Kosovo.

questions.q: Which singer born to Albanian parents had a hit with 'New Rules'?
questions.why: Her family is from Kosovo.

questions.q: Which Albanian writer wrote 'The General of the Dead Army'?
questions.why: He won the first Man Booker International Prize.

questions.q: In which year did Albania join NATO?
questions.why: It joined with Croatia.

questions.q: Which Ottoman governor ruled Ioannina and much of Albania in the 1800s?
questions.why: Lord Byron visited him.

questions.q: Which bird is on Albania's flag?
questions.why: Albanians call their country Shqipëria, 'land of eagles'.

questions.q: Which saint of Albanian heritage worked with the poor in India?
questions.why: Tirana's airport is named after her.

questions.q: Which concrete structures did Hoxha build across the country?
questions.why: There were over 170,000.

questions.q: Which code of customary law governed the northern highlands?
questions.why: It includes rules on blood feuds.

questions.q: What is Albania's currency?
questions.why: It is named after Alexander the Great (Leka).

questions.q: Which spring near Saranda is famous for its deep blue water?
questions.why: Divers have not reached its bottom.

questions.q: Which baked lamb and yoghurt dish is a national favourite?
questions.why: It comes from Elbasan.
